questions.question_text:
A cone has base radius $15\text{ cm}$ and perpendicular height $20\text{ cm}$.
Find the slant height $l$.

options.why: Subtracted the squares instead of adding them, treating the slant height as a shorter side.
Added the radius and perpendicular height directly instead of adding their squares and taking the square root.
Stopped at $l^{2}=625$ and forgot to take the square root.
Used the full base edge $24$ instead of half the base edge as the leg.
Subtracted, computing $\sqrt{24^{2}-5^{2}}$ instead of using half the edge and adding.
Added half the base edge and the height directly ($12+5$) without squaring.

questions.solution_text:
Half the base edge is $24\div2=12\text{ cm}$.
$l=\sqrt{5^{2}+12^{2}}$
$=\sqrt{169}$
$=13\text{ cm}$

questions.question_text:
A right square pyramid has base edge $26\text{ cm}$ and perpendicular height $21\text{ cm}$.
Find the slant height $l$ of a triangular face in exact surd form.
